typed_absence_rule: Unknown real names, authority channels, endpoints, credentials, keys and attestations remain typed_absent; local evidence cannot fill them.

packages.recovery: Real named authority material and attestation basis change; freeze input and independently verify.
packages.reject: Missing/ambiguous witness, non-unique owner, stale hash, or local-only assertion.

packages.recovery: Real trust chain and verifier material change; fresh freeze and independent verification.
packages.reject: Unverifiable signature, unknown chain, missing revocation/freshness, or foreign source reference.

packages.recovery: Authoritative source/environment closure changes; recompute hashes and independently verify.
packages.reject: Incomplete closure, mismatched input hash, unknown owner, or unsupported G2 mapping.

packages.recovery: A real external source is supplied and its authority, binding and freshness are independently verified.
packages.reject: Repository-local discovery presented as external fact, ambiguous provenance, or provider/source dropout.

common_recovery: External materials must actually change before one fresh S3 authority recheck; unchanged input forbids new AD and rerun.
common_rejection: No publish, no gate promotion, and no formal credit while any required external input remains typed_absent.
